Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) is not in combination with any other live viral agents.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the additional viruses or antigens are not inactivated.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the modified, live viruses are distinct and not in admixture with BVDV-lb.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism that does not include pestiviruses.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated and is not derived from virulent pestiviruses.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen not derived from live pestivirus strains.
